READ_THIS_FIRST.instruction_for_ai: DO NOT calculate totals from individual activities. Use the pre-calculated values in 'summary', 'weekly_summary', and 'derived_metrics' sections below. These are already computed accurately from the API data.
READ_THIS_FIRST.display_formatting: For durations and sleep, always display the '_formatted' fields (e.g., sleep_formatted, duration_formatted, total_training_formatted) instead of converting decimal '_hours' values. The formatted fields are pre-calculated from raw seconds and avoid rounding errors.
READ_THIS_FIRST.extended_data_note: ACWR and baselines calculated from 28 days of data
READ_THIS_FIRST.capability_metrics_note: The 'capability' block in derived_metrics contains durability trend (aggregate decoupling 7d/28d), efficiency factor trend (aggregate EF 7d/28d), HRRc trend (heart rate recovery 7d/28d), TID comparison (7d vs 28d distribution drift), power curve delta (MMP shift at anchor durations across 28d windows — energy system adaptation direction), HR curve delta (max sustained HR shift at anchor durations — cardiac adaptation, cross-sport), sustainability profile (per-sport power/HR sustainability table for race estimation — 42d window, sport-filtered), and DFA a1 profile (per-session non-linear HRV index from AlphaHRV Connect IQ field — latest_session + trailing_by_sport with crossing-band LT1/LT2 estimates). These measure HOW the athlete expresses fitness, not just load. Use these for coaching context alongside traditional load metrics. Durability and EF trend direction matters more than absolute values. HRRc is display only — higher = better parasympathetic recovery. Power curve delta rotation_index reveals whether gains are sprint-biased (positive) or endurance-biased (negative). HR curve delta is ambiguous — rising max sustained HR may indicate fitness or fatigue; cross-reference with resting HRV/HR and RPE. Sustainability profile provides race estimation lookup: actual MMP, Coggan predicted (cycling only), CP/W' model (cycling only), model_divergence_pct (actual vs CP — divergence IS the coaching signal). CP/W' is primary for durations ≤20min; Coggan duration factors are the established reference for ≥60min. Source flag (observed_outdoor/observed_indoor) matters for cycling race estimation — indoor MMP is typically 3-5% lower. DFA a1 profile: thresholds (1.0 ≈ LT1, 0.5 ≈ LT2) cycling-validated only — non-cycling sports get rollups but validated=False. Crossing-band estimates: HR is pooled across all sessions; watts are split by environment for cycling (watts_outdoor, watts_indoor with per-environment n_sessions) — compare watts_outdoor against ftp, watts_indoor against ftp_indoor. Non-cycling sports keep pooled watts. Estimates are provisional at confidence='low' (suppressed for calibration delta surfacing) and usable at 'moderate' or 'high'. DFA a1 is a Tier-2 interpretive signal — does NOT enter readiness P0–P3 ladder, does NOT auto-update dossier zones; surfaces calibration deltas only. Quality gate: refuse to interpret when latest_session.sufficient=false or trailing confidence=null. See SECTION_11.md DFA a1 Protocol for full interpretation rules.
READ_THIS_FIRST.readiness_decision_note: The 'readiness_decision' block contains a pre-computed go/modify/skip recommendation with priority level (P0=safety, P1=overload, P2=fatigue, P3=green), individual signal statuses, phase-adjusted thresholds, and structured modification guidance. Use this as the baseline for pre-workout recommendations. Override with explanation in the coach note if the AI's contextual judgment disagrees.

wellness_field_scales.note: All categorical wellness fields use a 1-4 positional scale where 1 = best state, 4 = worst state. Labels differ per field but direction is consistent. Fields are null when not reported.
wellness_field_scales.menstrual: menstrual_phase and menstrual_phase_predicted are not on the 1-4 scale. Values: PERIOD, FOLLICULAR, OVULATION, LUTEAL, etc.

durability.reliability_note: insufficient qualifying sessions for alert evaluation: 7d N=1 (min 3), 28d N=4 (min 5)
durability.note: Steady-state power sessions only (VI <= 1.05, VI > 0, >= 90min, power data). Negative decoupling = strong durability. Trend compares 7d vs 28d mean (+/-1% = stable). Alerts require N28>=5 (alarm) or N7>=3 AND N28>=5 (declining warning) for statistical reliability.

efficiency_factor.note: Steady-state cycling sessions only (VI <= 1.05, VI > 0, >= 20min, power+HR data). Rising EF = improving aerobic efficiency. Compare like-for-like sessions only — EF varies with intensity. Trend compares 7d vs 28d mean (+/-0.03 = stable).

hrrc.note: HRRc = heart rate recovery (largest 60s HR drop in bpm after exceeding threshold HR for >1 min). Higher = better parasympathetic recovery. Null when threshold not reached, recording stopped before cooldown, or no HR data. Trend: 7d mean vs 28d mean, >10% = meaningful (min 1 session/7d, 3 sessions/28d). Display only — not wired into readiness_decision signals.

tid_comparison.note: Compares 7d vs 28d Seiler TID to detect distribution shifts. pi_delta positive = more polarized acutely.

power_curve_delta.note: Compares MMP at 5 anchor durations (5s neuromuscular, 60s anaerobic, 300s MAP, 1200s threshold, 3600s endurance) across two 28d windows. rotation_index = mean(5s,60s pct_change) - mean(1200s,3600s pct_change). Positive = sprint-biased gains, negative = endurance-biased. 300s excluded from rotation (transitional). Null when either window has fewer than 3 valid anchor durations.

hr_curve_delta.note: Compares max sustained HR at 4 anchor durations (60s anaerobic ceiling, 300s VO2max HR, 1200s threshold HR, 3600s endurance HR) across two 28d windows. rotation_index = mean(60s,300s pct_change) - mean(1200s,3600s pct_change). Positive = intensity-biased HR shift, negative = endurance-biased. No sport filter — HR is cross-sport physiological (dominated by hardest efforts). IMPORTANT: rising max sustained HR is ambiguous — may indicate improved cardiac output (good) or accumulated fatigue/dehydration/heat (bad). Cross-reference with resting HRV, resting HR, RPE, and environmental context before interpreting. Null when either window has fewer than 3 valid anchor durations.

cycling.model_trust_note: CP/W' model (P=CP+W'/t) is primary for durations ≤20min where W' contribution is meaningful. Coggan duration factors (Allen & Coggan, 3rd ed.) are the established reference for ≥60min. 30min is the crossover zone where both apply. model_divergence_pct = (actual - CP_model) / CP_model × 100. Positive divergence at short durations may indicate strong anaerobic capacity or stale W' value. Indoor MMP is typically 3-5% lower than outdoor (cooling, motivation) — source flag indicates which environment produced each anchor.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W37 HARZ - Optional Sonnenberg Leg-Opener 35–45min
planned_workouts.description:
WORKOUT STRUCTURE
- 5m 45-55% FTP
- 35m 55-65% FTP
- 5m 45-55% FTP

PURPOSE
Optional post-drive leg-opener from the Sankt Andreasberg apartment. This should loosen the legs without taking anything from Saturday's key ride.

ROUTE
Ride north toward Sonnenberg and return on the same road. The mapped out-and-back is approximately 10.4 km with 227 m ascent. Turn at Sonnenberg or when the outbound clock reaches twenty to twenty-two minutes, whichever comes first.

ROUTE MAP
https://brouter.de/brouter-web/#map=13/51.7398/10.5170/standard&lonlats=10.520490,51.718523;10.512309,51.761088;10.520490,51.718523&profile=fastbike

EXECUTION
Keep normal riding mainly between 145 and 170 W. Hold sustained climbing at or below approximately 175 W, with no tempo, surges or speed target. Coast and descend conservatively on the return. RPE should remain 1 to 2.

SHORTEN OR SKIP
If arrival is late, conditions are poor, or the drive leaves the legs or concentration stale, turn after fifteen minutes or skip the ride entirely. It is activation only, not a third quality day.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W37 KEY OVERLOAD - Brocken–Oker 125.7km / 2,332m
planned_workouts.description:
WORKOUT STRUCTURE
- 30m 50-68% FTP
- 270m 55-80% FTP
- 30m 45-68% FTP

KEY OVERLOAD — PRIMARY ROUTE
Exact route: Brocken Summit–Oker Reservoir loop, 125.7 km and 2,332 m ascent, starting and ending at the apartment in Sankt Andreasberg.

ROUTE MAP
https://www.komoot.com/tour/3271471731?share_token=a5WQvoOfXa82gx7Z3RGAIhDK1LAQ6p0SM3Kuv7kMzp48ThK0Hf&ref=wtd&t_s=referral&t_cid=route_share&t_ref_username=4244674268796

WHY THIS ROUTE
This is the athlete-approved replacement for the superseded Great Western Harz route. It combines a major training stimulus with enjoyment and scenery. Completing the planned loop is full success; reaching 150 km is not required.

ATHLETE-CALIBRATED TIME AND LOAD
Expected moving time is 5h10 to 5h45, centred on 5h30. Expected elapsed time with photos and refills is approximately 5h45 to 6h45. Expected power load is approximately 210 to 260, centred around 236. Load is a forecast, not a target to chase.

ROUTE-SPECIFIC PACING — OUTDOOR FTP APPROXIMATELY 265 W
Overall NP should emerge around 170 to 178 W; do not chase it. Before the Brocken approach, use 150 to 175 W on workable terrain and 180 to 195 W on sustained climbs. On Brockenstraße around km 29 to 39, stay mainly at 180 to 195 W with a sustained ceiling of 200 W. Put on the packable layer before the high descent and let safety override power.

Through the middle section, return to 150 to 175 W without crest surges. On the late Kalbetal and Torfhaus climbing block from roughly km 108, use 180 to 200 W by default. Allow up to 205 W only when fueling, RPE, cadence and coordination remain normal. Keep short unavoidable ramps below approximately 225 to 238 W. Avoid sustained HR above 150 bpm before the final 30 km. Reduce climb targets by 10 to 15 W immediately if HR or RPE rises while power falls.

SURFACE AND ACCESS
The route contains approximately 3.7 km of cobbles and about 0.8 km of compacted or unpaved surface. Four short Komoot unsuitable flags total approximately 0.75 km. Ride them cautiously, especially when damp. The plotted approach uses Brockenstraße; the published National Park closure concerns Hirtenstieg. Final live route and weather status still governs.

FUEL AND STOPS
Consume 90 g carbohydrate per hour beginning within 20 minutes, giving approximately 460 to 515 g for the expected moving duration. Drink approximately 500 to 750 ml per hour according to conditions. Brocken summit is around km 39. The main resupply and lunch corridor is Wernigerode to Ilsenburg around km 66 to 75; replenish fully before the Oker and Kalbetal section. Torfhaus may provide a later backup if open. Lunch counts toward the hourly total but does not replace continuous intake. Carry at least one extra hour of emergency carbohydrate.

OPTIONAL EXTENSION
After completing the planned loop, twenty to forty minutes of familiar, low-risk riding at no more than 65% FTP is optional only when RPE is no higher than 4, fueling and coordination remain normal, there is no focal pain, and weather, daylight and handling remain safe. Do not extend to hit 150 km, a duration number or a load target.

SOLO SAFETY
Download the exact route offline. Carry front and rear lights, live tracking, plugs, tube, tyre boot, pump or CO2, packable layer, power bank and payment backup. Stop or shorten for unsafe weather, impaired handling or concentration, illness, pain, or inability to fuel.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W37 HARZ - Recovery Ride Before Drive 45–60min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: AE-4 Active Recovery, adapted for the morning after the Brocken–Oker key overload and before a 6–7-hour drive home.
Adaptation target: circulation and low-stress scenic riding only. Saturday already supplies the training stimulus.

- 10m at 45–55% FTP = 119–146 W
- 40m at 50–60% FTP = 133–159 W
- 10m at 45–55% FTP = 119–146 W

Outdoor FTP basis: 265 W. RPE 1. Choose the flattest practical route; cap unavoidable climbs at 65% FTP / 172 W and use easy gearing. No tempo, no hard finishes and no distance objective.
Duration rule: default 45–60 minutes. Extend only to 75 minutes if walking/stairs are normal, there is no focal pain, concentration is normal and the first 20 minutes feel genuinely restorative. Skip entirely for poor sleep, focal pain, unsafe weather, impaired handling/concentration or severe heaviness. Do not repay skipped work after the drive.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W38 - Home Strength Viability Hold 35min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: individualized home-strength foundation; pull-up bar and bodyweight only.
Adaptation target: establish a repeatable movement dose without impairing cycling quality.
Dose hold: recent strength load/repetitions/RIR and 24–48-hour soreness are not recorded, so no progression is inferred from strength TSS.

Warm-up 5 minutes. Then use controlled technique and normal rests:
- Reverse lunge: 2 x 8 each side
- Bodyweight split squat: 2 x 8 each side
- Single-leg hip bridge: 2 x 10 each side
- Hamstring walkout: 2 x 6
- Push-up: 2 x 8–15
- Pull-up or chin-up: 2 controlled submaximal sets
- Single-leg calf raise: 2 x 12–15 each side
- Side plank: 2 x 25 seconds each side

Stop every set with at least 3 RIR; no failure or grinders. Record actual repetitions, hardest-set RIR, pain/setup friction, next-day soreness and whether cycling is affected. Omit the session for residual Harz soreness, joint pain or altered movement quality. Progress one variable only after a clean recorded response.
Readiness gate: use the current Section 11 readiness decision plus new athlete-reported illness, sleep, soreness, pain, coordination and in-session response. Athlete-reported adverse state overrides favorable modeled metrics. Do not repay reduced or missed work.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W38 HARD - Indoor ERG Post-Harz Sweet Spot 2x20 70min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: SS-1 Sustained Sweet Spot Blocks, deliberately reduced for the post-Harz exception.
Adaptation target: one controlled sustained-power touch after the longest-ever ride, not repayment of displaced W37 work.

Accepted indoor setting is 254 W. Each ERG step has one exact target; 90% is approximately 229 W. This reduces main work from W37's planned 2 x 27 minutes (54 minutes) to 2 x 20 minutes (40 minutes) at unchanged intensity. The reduction is explicitly for post-overload recovery, not evidence of lost capacity.

- 10m 55% FTP
- 5m 75% FTP
- 20m 90% FTP
- 5m 50% FTP
- 20m 90% FTP
- 10m 55% FTP

GO only if Harz execution, fueling, sleep, soreness, coordination and current readiness are all supportive by Friday. For any named adverse response, replace the entire session with 60 minutes easy aerobic at one exact 65% FTP ERG target; do not introduce VO2 and do not move quality later in the week. RPE target 6–7, stable cadence, no second-interval increase.
Readiness gate: use the current Section 11 readiness decision plus new athlete-reported illness, sleep, soreness, pain, coordination and in-session response. Athlete-reported adverse state overrides favorable modeled metrics. Do not repay reduced or missed work.
